assessment_basis: Defective behavior change. getDomainAxisIndex documents -1 for an axis not assigned to this plot. With a child plot owning its own domain axis and a different parent axis, the candidate returns 0 for the parent axis although child.getDomainAxis(0) remains its own different axis. Recompiled full class plus actual dependencies reproduces reference -1 versus candidate 0. The pre-existing range-axis fallback does not override the domain-axis contract.
